subject: website
name: Orivon website
summary: The Orivon release website, judged here by its own publisher. Its source is public (Apache-2.0) and it is served as written, so it runs only its own code: no analytics, tag manager or embed. As it opens it reads the newest release from latest.orivonstack.eth.limo, which Orivon loads from latest.orivonstack.eth and checks, so nothing it shows rests on a server: Level 4. Not private: that read shows the IPFS nodes serving the release folder the visitor's IP address.

operations.name: Read the project pages and choose a download
operations.note: The text, images, fonts and scripts are the page's own files.

operations.name: Show the newest release
operations.note: Read from latest.orivonstack.eth, checked against the name; the page's built-in release stands in when it does not answer.

connections.name: latest.orivonstack.eth, addressed as latest.orivonstack.eth.limo
connections.note: Orivon loads the gateway address from the name and checks every block. The nodes that serve it see the visitor's IP address.
